notes:
Account summary
- Mid-market SaaS helpdesk platform. Currently using Redwood Hosted API in production for:
  - Support-agent drafting (chat + tool calling)
  - Ticket summarization (batch)
  - Internal doc-search (embeddings)
- Cost sensitivity is high. They track unit cost per resolved ticket and want LLM costs to be predictable month-over-month.

Current usage / technical
- Regions: primary us-east-1; secondary eu-west for EU tenant traffic. Noted that fallback sometimes crosses regions during capacity events.
- Models: mixture of a larger chat model for agent drafting and a smaller model for summaries. They explicitly asked for reporting by model variant and by region (so they can explain changes to their finance team).
- Observability asks:
  - Monthly export (CSV) of total output tokens, blended $/1M output tokens, and effective rate by region/model.
  - A view of cache impact (prefix/KV hit rate) to explain cost variance when prompt patterns change.

Billing / reconciliation
- Support escalation SUP-8841: "Invoice doesn’t match our internal tracking for EU usage". Their internal breakdown showed higher eu-west costs than expected.
- Investigation notes (internal): likely contributors were region mapping edge cases + late metering events landing after daily aggregation cutoff. After backfill + mapping fix, variance narrowed. Customer wants this to be systematic going forward.
- Customer quote from QBR: "We don’t need per-request costs, but we do need something that reconciles to the invoice and tells us what changed (model, region, cache)."

Security / compliance
- SSO/SAML required (already enabled). Wants audit logging and retention controls. Data residency is a concern because they have EU tenants; they asked how we treat cross-region fallback for cost reporting and whether we can pin EU tenants to EU-only routing.

Expansion / next steps
- They are not asking for Dedicated yet, but they are evaluating Optimize guidance (batching/caching/quant profiles) if it can reduce $/1M output tokens without quality regressions.
- Action items:
  - Provide a sample monthly unit-cost export format (by model, region, customer tier not needed on their side).
  - Align on a reconciliation approach/tolerance (target: invoice tie-out within agreed bounds; document treatment of credits/discounts vs usage rates).
